checks.query: SELECT b.FirstName,b.Surname,i.InvoiceDate FROM Buyer AS b JOIN Invoice AS i ON b.BuyerID=i.BuyerID WHERE b.FirstName='Mira' AND b.Surname='Shah';

SELECT m.Surname FROM Member m JOIN Loan l ON m.MemberID=l.MemberID
WHERE l.DateOut='2027-03-01' AND l.DateRet='2027-03-05';
SELECT P.SupplierID,P.ProductName FROM Product P JOIN Stock S ON P.ProductID=S.ProductID WHERE S.Quantity BETWEEN 25 AND 35 AND P.Description LIKE'%fruity%';
SELECT e.FirstName,e.Surname,r.Grade FROM Employee AS e JOIN Role AS r ON e.RoleID=r.RoleID WHERE e.Surname='Patel' AND r.Grade=8;
SELECT e.FirstName,e.Surname,r.Grade FROM Employee e JOIN Role r ON e.RoleID=r.RoleID WHERE e.Surname='Chen' AND r.Grade=8;
SELECT r.DeviceID FROM Reading r JOIN Technician t ON r.TechID=t.TechID WHERE t.Name='R. Kim' AND r.RecordedAt >= '2027-05-12 00:00' AND r.RecordedAt < '2027-05-13 00:00';
SELECT O.DeviceID FROM Observation O JOIN Technician T ON O.TechnicianID=T.TechnicianID WHERE T.Name='Ari Singh' AND O.RecordedAt >= '2026-05-12 00:00:00' AND O.RecordedAt < '2026-05-13 00:00:00';

limits: These questions use portable SELECT/JOIN/WHERE/BETWEEN/LIKE. Data tests discriminate correct join, multiple filter conditions, duplicate retention and inclusive range endpoints. Other dialect syntax is not assumed.
